big_case.notes: Formed on the record and outcome before weighing the predictors' scores. Intervenor challenge to a court-drawn Section 2 remedial map for one Washington state legislative district (Soto Palmer v. Hobbs), with a companion petition (Garcia v. Hobbs, 25-901). The two questions (intervenor standing to attack an unappealed liability judgment; strict scrutiny for race-conscious remedial maps) have national reach, but the Court disposed of it by GVR in light of Louisiana v. Callais rather than taking it up, so its own footprint is one district and one remand in the first post-Callais wave. Moderate stakes, well short of a landmark.
